snippet.title: Halo MCC: Halo CE Campaign Mod - Crash Site
snippet.description:
What's going on homies and welcome back everyone to another Halo CE campaign mod showcase! In this video, we continue checking out more Dig Site content, this time looking at a remaking/reimagining of the Halo 1999 build. This is Crash Site, created by Neo The Aika, Sean, Ludus, and xScruffyDaSasquatchx!

Download link: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3002260635

Go beyond in an original mission by members from Digsite, Crash Site invites you right to the fight, reinforcing allies & eliminating Covenant on the search to uncover the island's mysteries.
Current Build Ver. for Crash Site is 23.07.13g
Your version number is displayed in-game in the mods list and the mission's opening text.
Crash Site requires that both H1 Campaign and H1 Multiplayer are installed.

- Explore an ancient island in a full-scale campaign experience.
- Solo, cooperative, or reinforced with marines, the approach is your call.
- A single connected space with no load zones, Crash Site pushes the engine to the limits.
- Gear up with prototype equipment, available to wield for the first time.
- New exclusive soundtrack, authentically produced with the equipment used on Halo CE.

CREDITS
-  Mission design by Ludus & Neo Te Aika.
-  Additional encounters by Scruffy & Sean T.
-  Sound and music authored by Neo Te Aika.
-  Updated prerelease Halo assets by Digsite Team.
-  Halo 1749 tags extracted from Xbox build 1749, converted with Invader.[github.com]

A non-Steam version of Crash Site for PC players will be available from July 24, 2023.
Updates for this project are ongoing, incl. performance optimization, music and more.
(We recommend the Steam Workshop version, which features automatic updates)
